title: Tales Beyond The Tomb - Pineville Night Stalker
description:
“Tales Beyond The Tomb” is a chilling episodic horror series that immerses players in the shadows of real-life cases. 

Inspired by the gritty, atmospheric horror of the 80s and 90s, each episode simulates the frightening experiences of real people, mixing nostalgia with unrelenting suspense.

This is the first episode of the series:

Episode 1: Pineville Night StalkerAfter her mother's unexpected death, Megan receives a call about a sudden and mysterious inheritance awaiting in the desolate town of Pineville. With her work friend, Lenny – she embarks on a journey that should be simple, but quickly turns into a web of danger and deceit.

Key Features• VHS Aesthetic — Step back in time with visuals inspired by classic horror films of the ’80s and ’90s.

• Photorealistic Graphics & Immersive Environments — Feel the dread with lifelike visuals and haunting settings.

• Voice Activity — Interaction system with your microphone (no microphone is needed to play, but this increases your interaction and involves a complete experience).

• Dialog Text System — Immerse yourself in the plot with dynamic, narrative-driven dialogues.

GameplayA first-person exploration experience (walking simulator), where realism is fundamental. Navigate immersive locations, discover disturbing truths, and face your fears.
description_short: After her mother's unexpected death, Megan receives a call about a mysterious inheritance awaiting her in the town of Pineville. With her work friend, Lenny, she embarks on a journey that should be simple, but quickly turns into a web of danger and deception.
